title: Markov Properties of $k$-Record Processes via Order Statistics
summary: The theory of $k$-record values (Type 2 $k$-records) plays an important role in the study of partial extremes and in statistical inference based on record data. A common approach reduces the analysis of $k$-records associated with a distribution function $F$ to that of ordinary records from the transformed distribution $F_{1:k}(x)=1-(1-F(x))^k$.
